target.build: Dataset-derived embedded firmware sample from i12/vul1. The blind workspace should expose the binary and surrounding files, but not the oracle description or PoC.

task_profile.notes: Tenda i12 httpd binary. formexeCommand handler at /goform/exeCommand reads cmdinput parameter and passes it to vos_strcpy without bounds check.

ground_truth.root_cause: The formexeCommand handler reads the user-provided 'cmdinput' parameter via websGetVar and passes it to vos_strcpy(s + 4, Var) without any length check, which overflows the stack-based buffer. vos_strcpy is a wrapper around strcpy with no bounds checking.
